motivation_es: Las iniciaciones del sell-side detenidas en el riesgo de concentracion de clientes no pueden lanzarse sin datos de campo independientes; suministrar esos datos es lo que monetiza la suscripcion de channel-check frente al cohort de IPO de aceleradores de IA.
motivation_fil: Ang sell-side initiations na nakapako sa customer-concentration risk ay hindi pwedeng i-ship nang walang independent field data; ang pagsuplay ng field data na iyon ang nagmo-monetize sa channel-check subscription laban sa AI-accelerator IPO cohort.

outcome: A published index-committee determination confirming CBRS inclusion eligibility for the next standard S&P Total Market Index addition track or Russell 1000 reconstitution path inside the Q3 2026 rebalance window.

motivation_fil: Ang inclusion-eligibility determinations ay ang standard methodology-driven workflow ng index-provider; ang pagpapaproseso sa CBRS sa parehong gates sa parehong iskedyul ang lumilikha ng index-inclusion confirmation na kailangan ng prediction landing.

actor: AUM-top-twenty long-only asset manager AI-infrastructure sector portfolio manager and supporting analyst
actor_ja: AUM上位20社の長期投資型アセットマネジャーにおけるAIインフラ・セクターのポートフォリオ・マネジャーとサポート・アナリスト
actor_es: portfolio manager del sector de infraestructura de IA en una gestora long-only del top-20 por AUM y su analista de apoyo
actor_fil: AUM-top-twenty long-only asset manager AI-infrastructure sector portfolio manager at supporting analyst
job: Run the second-tier model-portfolio addition diligence on CBRS using the sell-side initiation cohort plus the channel-check decks plus the index-inclusion eligibility track as the anchoring inputs.
job_ja: セルサイドのイニシエーション・コホート、チャネルチェック資料、およびインデックス組入適格性トラックを基軸インプットとして用い、CBRSのセカンドティア・モデル・ポートフォリオ追加ディリジェンスを実施する。
job_es: Ejecutar la diligencia de incorporacion al model portfolio de segundo nivel sobre CBRS usando como insumos ancla el cohort de iniciaciones del sell-side, los dossiers de channel-checks y la senda de elegibilidad de inclusion en indices.
job_fil: Patatakbuhin ang second-tier model-portfolio addition diligence sa CBRS gamit ang sell-side initiation cohort, channel-check decks, at index-inclusion eligibility track bilang anchoring inputs.
outcome: A confirmed second-tier model-portfolio CBRS add at one of two-plus AUM-top-twenty long-only managers, satisfying the prediction's required long-only-anchored holding marker.
outcome_ja: AUM上位20社の長期投資型マネジャーのうち2社以上での確認済みセカンドティア・モデル・ポートフォリオへのCBRS追加で、予測が要求する長期投資家アンカー保有のマーカーを満たす。
outcome_es: Una incorporacion confirmada de CBRS al model portfolio de segundo nivel en al menos dos de las gestoras long-only del top-20 por AUM, cumpliendo el marcador de holding anclado en long-only que exige la prediccion.
outcome_fil: Isang nakumpirmang second-tier model-portfolio CBRS add sa isa sa dalawa-o-higit pang AUM-top-twenty long-only managers, tumutugon sa kinakailangang long-only-anchored holding marker ng prediction.
motivation: Once buyside float has crossed the half-of-float graduation threshold and the sell-side initiation cohort is converging, long-only AI-infra desks risk underweight-versus-benchmark performance drag if they delay the model-portfolio add into Q4.
motivation_ja: バイサイドのフロートが半数超の卒業閾値を上抜け、セルサイドのイニシエーション・コホートが収斂しつつある以上、長期投資型のAIインフラ・デスクがモデル・ポートフォリオへの組み入れをQ4に先送りすれば、ベンチマーク対比のアンダーウェイトによるパフォーマンス低下リスクを負うことになる。
motivation_es: Una vez que el buyside ha cruzado el umbral de graduacion de mas de la mitad del float y el cohort de iniciaciones del sell-side esta convergiendo, los desks long-only de infraestructura de IA arriesgan un lastre de rendimiento por subponderacion frente al benchmark si demoran la incorporacion al model portfolio hasta Q4.
motivation_fil: Pagkatapos tumawid ng buyside float sa half-of-float graduation threshold at habang nag-co-converge ang sell-side initiation cohort, ang long-only AI-infra desks ay may panganib ng underweight-versus-benchmark performance drag kung itutulak nila ang model-portfolio add sa Q4.
